spans.s: गवादि a class of words headed by the word गो to which the affix यत् is affixed in the senses men- tioned in rules from P.
; e. g. गव्यम् , हविष्यम् युग्यम् , मेध्यम् etc.; cf. Kas. on P.
गवाश्वप्रभृति the dvandva compound words गवाश्व, गवाविक गवैडक, अजाविक, कुब्जमाणवक, पुत्रपौत्र मांसशोणित and others which are to be declined in the neuter gender and singular number; cf.
गाव a technical term for the term अाङ्ग (pertaining to the base in the grammar of Panini); cf. वार्णात् गावं बलीयः Kat.
